title: MTP700 unifi basic HMI Cannot Write Commands to Siemens S7-1200 PLC
op_body_verbatim:
Hello everyone,

I am facing a problem with an MTP700 HMI connected to a Siemens S7-1200 PLC.

I have configured the communication, PLC tags, and HMI buttons in TIA Portal. However, when I press a button on the HMI to activate a PLC output, nothing happens.

I have previously worked successfully with an S7-1200 PLC and a KTP700 Basic PN HMI. I also remember that my MTP700 and S7-1200 setup worked correctly before, so I am struggling to identify the cause.

As shown in Figures 1 and 2, all settings appear to be correct, and both the PLC and HMI programs were downloaded successfully without any errors. However, the problem persists, and the HMI still does not respond to commands. I would appreciate any suggestions or advice to help identify the cause of this issue.

I would appreciate any suggestions regarding possible communication settings, PLC security parameters, HMI write permissions, or compatibility issues.

My configuration:

PLC: Siemens S7-1200, CPU model: [1214 DC/DC/DC]
HMI: MTP700,  Unifi basic 
TIA Portal version: V19
Has anyone experienced a similar problem or found a solution?

Thank you for your help.
